query:
SELECT e.id, e.fullName, d.id as deviceId, d.deviceFingerprint, d.status, d.createdAt, d.approvedAt
FROM devices d
JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.employeeId
WHERE e.fullName LIKE '%許玉%'
ORDER BY d.createdAt DESC;
